name: Hannover 96
description: As the flagship of the state capital, Hannover 96 combines sport and urban culture. The Reds support local initiatives and promote togetherness in Linden.

name: gourmego
description: gourmego is a specialist in natural ice cream raw materials without flavorings and colorants. NAPURESS® quality from the wholesaler for ice cream manufacturers and ice cream parlors in Europe.

name: Bauer Banse
description: Farm sales and weekly markets: Bauer Banse brings fresh farm products from Kakerbeck to Hanover – including to the markets in Linden and Lister Meile.

name: Backring Nord
description: The largest private specialist wholesale company for ice cream parlors and bakeries in Germany. Backring Nord stands for quality, advice, and reliable delivery.

name: Leibniz
description: Bahlsen Leibniz – the original with 52 teeth from Hanover. From classic to Choco: the ideal accompaniment to a creamy sundae or a strong coffee.

name: Machwitz Kaffee
description: Awarded as the best roastery in Lower Saxony: Since 1883, Machwitz Kaffee has combined craftsmanship and fair direct trade for exceptional coffee enjoyment.

name: Waffelfabrik
description: Professional ice cream cones for ice cream parlors and manufacturers. The Waffelfabrik produces ice cream cones and waffle cups in consistent quality for the ice cream trade.
